description.value: De Dutch is a BC-born breakfast and brunch chain founded in 1975, best known for authentic Dutch pannekoeken — large, thin 12-inch pancakes served sweet or savoury. The Burrard Landing location sits at Canada Place near Vancouver's waterfront, placing it squarely on the popular Stanley Park seawall cycling route. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients including preservative-free bread, fresh-pressed orange juice, and Canadian-made Edam cheese.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 14m; rack at 16m; rack (16 spaces) at 60m; stands (covered) at 75m; stands (covered) at 82m. Total: 16 spaces.
